# RegisterBox

RegisterBox provides guided business-registration preparation and compliance workspaces in India. The team is based in Bengaluru. Public service guides explain eligibility factors, documents, government-fee components, realistic timelines, common filing issues, State differences and links to responsible authorities.

- [Food business and FSSAI](https://www.registerbox.in/services/fssai-food-business)

- [Trademark application](https://www.registerbox.in/services/trademark-registration)

## Important boundaries

- RegisterBox fees are professional assistance charges and are stated separately from government fees.
- Application drafts, receipts and preparation status are not government approvals or successful filings.
- Information pages are reviewed against linked official sources but are not CA, CS, legal or tax opinions.
- Eligibility, jurisdiction, current fees and professional-review requirements are confirmed for the customer’s facts before an authorised submission.

## Published RegisterBox service fees

- GST registration assistance: INR 199.
- Eligible nil GST filing: INR 0 RegisterBox service fee. Other work and any statutory dues are separate.
- FSSAI registration/licence assistance: INR 3,999.
- Private limited company assistance: ask for a quotation.
- MSME/Udyam registration assistance: free.
- Labour/shop licence assistance: INR 4,500.
- Government fees, taxes and exceptional third-party costs are separate unless the written scope expressly says otherwise.
